consent.title: Turn on the microphone for this recording
consent.explanation: This app needs the microphone only while you record. Press the button below and choose Allow when asked.

denied.title: The microphone is blocked
denied.explanation: Your Mac is keeping this app from using the microphone.
denied.recovery_path: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone → turn on this app, then press the button again

in_browser.explanation: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site.
in_browser.recovery_path: Click the icon left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then press the button again

unavailable.title: Microphone recording is unavailable here
unavailable.explanation: This app window does not provide microphone capture. You can still use Pick an audio file.

payload.label: Record audio
payload.description: Captures browser or adapter-provided media, stages bytes through reusable material evidence, stores local playback refs separately, and publishes descriptor-driven media records through workflow.

payload.name: record-audio-save-recording-state
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped capture lifecycle event.

payload.name: record-audio-save-captured-media
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped media record with reusable material evidence and local playback refs.

payload.name: record-audio-save-recording-error
payload.description: Save one descriptor-scoped capture error event.

payload.name: record-audio-begin-recording-note
payload.description: Make the meeting note of a recording the moment it starts, so it exists and can be written in while recording; the finished recording fills it in.

payload.name: record-audio-set-recording-name
payload.description: Replace the display-name field record without touching media metadata or other fields.

payload.name: record-audio-remove-recording
payload.description: Atomically retract every segment of one media record from the maintained projection.

payload.name: record-audio-set-recording-notes
payload.description: Replace the notes field record without touching media metadata or other fields.

payload.name: record-audio-set-recording-subtitle
payload.description: Replace the subtitle field record without touching media metadata or other fields.
